קפג.ja: ען תדביר נפסה, ואלאסיר פי יד עדווה, ומן פקד נעמה סאבגה, ואלנאדם עלי עציאנה לרבה, ואלבאכי עלי מא סלף לה מן אלד'נוב כ'וף עקאב אללה.
קפג.en: with the ignorant in the management of his soul; with the captive in the hand of his enemy; with the one deprived of an earlier blessing; with the one regretful of his disobedience to his Lord; with the one weeping over the offenses that have passed for him out of fear of God's punishment.

pairs.en: with the captive in the hand of his enemy
with the one deprived of an earlier blessing
with the one regretful of his disobedience to his Lord

pairs.ja: ואלבאכי עלי מא סלף לה מן אלד'נוב
pairs.en: with the one weeping over the offenses that have passed for him
out of fear of God's punishment

קפג.ja: ואמא מוצ'ע אלקסאוה פענד אכ'ד' חקוק אללה מן אלעצאה, ואלאנתקאם מן אלמפסדין פי אלארץ', כקול אלכתאב לא תחוס עינך עליו, וקאל ולא תחמול ולא תכסה עליו.
קפג.en: As for the place of severity: in taking God's rights from the disobedient, and in vengeance upon the corrupters in the earth, as the Book says: "Your eye shall not pity him" (Deuteronomy 13:9), and He said: "You shall not have mercy and shall not cover him" (Deuteronomy 13:9).

pairs.en: the place of severity

pairs.ja: פענד אכ'ד' חקוק אללה מן אלעצאה
pairs.en: in taking God's rights from the disobedient
and in vengeance upon the corrupters in the earth

קפג.ja: וכד'לך כ'לקא אלשמך' ואלכ'שוע, פמוצ'ע אלשמך' ואלאנפה אד'א ואפאך אהל אלג'הל באללה ואלמערצ'ון ענה פלא תתואצ'עי ולא תכ'צ'עי להם, בחית' יט'הר מנך אלתצדיק להם ואלתאת'יר למד'אהבהם אלפאסדה, בל אטלקי כ'לק אלאנפה ואלשמך' אלדאל עלי כ'לאף ראיהם וקלהֵ אלרצ'א ענהם, כמא עלמת מן קצהֵ מרדכי והמן.
קפג.en: So too the two traits of pride and humility. The place of pride and disdain: when there come to you the people of ignorance of God and those turned away from Him — do not be humble or submissive to them in such a way that there appears from you confirmation of them and influence-by their corrupt schools; rather, let loose the trait of disdain and pride that indicates the contrary of their view and the paucity of contentment with them — as you know from the story of Mordecai and Haman.

pairs.en: the two traits of pride and humility
The place of pride and disdain

pairs.ja: אד'א ואפאך אהל אלג'הל באללה ואלמערצ'ון ענה
pairs.en: when there come to you the people of ignorance of God and those turned away from Him
do not be humble or submissive to them
rather, let loose the trait of disdain and pride

pairs.ja: אלדאל עלי כ'לאף ראיהם וקלהֵ אלרצ'א ענהם
pairs.en: that indicates the contrary of their view and the paucity of contentment with them

pairs.ja: כמא עלמת מן קצהֵ מרדכי והמן
pairs.en: as you know from the story of Mordecai and Haman

קפג.ja: ומוצ'ע אסתעמאל אלכ'שוע ענד לקאיך ד'א פצ'ל ובר ונקי אללה, ועאלם בכתאבה, ועאמל בטאעתה, ומן לה עליך נעמה ואחסאן ילזמך מכאפאתה עליהא, ואחרי מן ג'לת ועט'מת נעמתה ען אן תכאפינה עליהא, וכד'לך ענד אכ'ד' אלקצאץ ללה מנך כמא קאל או אז יכנע לבבם הערל ואז ירצו את עונם.
קפג.en: The place of the deployment of humility: at your meeting one of bounty, righteousness, and pure-belief in God, knowledgeable of His Book, acting by obedience to Him, or one who has on you a blessing and beneficence binding you to its requital — and how much more for the One whose blessing has been too majestic and too great for you to requite Him for it; and likewise at God's taking justice from you, as He said: "Then their uncircumcised heart will be humbled, and then they shall make amends for their iniquity" (Leviticus 26:41).

pairs.en: The place of the deployment of humility

pairs.ja: ענד לקאיך ד'א פצ'ל ובר ונקי אללה
pairs.en: at your meeting one of bounty, righteousness, and pure-belief in God
knowledgeable of His Book
acting by obedience to Him
or one who has on you a blessing and beneficence
binding you to its requital

קפג.ja: וכד'לך כ'לקא אלמחבה ואלבגצ'ה, פמוצ'ע אלמחבה פליכן למן ואפקך עלי טאעהֵ אללה, ועלי מא יסרך פי עאקבהֵ אמרך.
קפג.en: So too the two traits of love and hatred. The place of love: let it be for the one who conforms to you in obedience to God, and in what gladdens you in the outcome of your matter.

pairs.en: the two traits of love and hatred
The place of love

pairs.ja: פליכן למן ואפקך עלי טאעהֵ אללה
pairs.en: let it be for the one who conforms to you in obedience to God

pairs.ja: ועלי מא יסרך פי עאקבהֵ אמרך
pairs.en: and in what gladdens you in the outcome of your matter

קפג.ja: ומוצ'ע אלבגצ'ה פלמן כ'אלף רצ'א אללה ועאנד אהל אלחק, וקאדך אלי מא יסכ'ט עליך רבך, כמא קאל עוזבי תורה יהללו רשע ושומרי תורה יתגרו בם.
קפג.en: The place of hatred: for whoever opposes the satisfaction of God and contends with the people of truth, and leads you to what displeases your Lord against you, as He said: "Those who forsake the Law praise the wicked, but those who keep the Law contend with them" (Proverbs 28:4).

pairs.en: The place of hatred
for whoever opposes the satisfaction of God
and contends with the people of truth

pairs.ja: וקאדך אלי מא יסכ'ט עליך רבך
pairs.en: and leads you to what displeases your Lord against you
as He said
Those who forsake the Law praise the wicked
but those who keep the Law contend with them

קפג.ja: וכד'לך כ'לקא אלסכ'א ואלבכ'ל, פמוצ'ע אלסכ'א וצ'ע כל שי פי מכאנה ואעטא כל ד'י פצ'ילה מן אלעלם ואלמאל בחסב מא יסתאהלהא, כקול אלולי ע"ס אל תמנע טוב
קפג.en: So too the two traits of generosity and stinginess. The place of generosity: the placing of every thing in its place, and giving every possessor of excellence of knowledge and wealth according to what he is worthy of, as the Friend (peace be upon him) said: "Do not withhold good

pairs.en: the two traits of generosity and stinginess
The place of generosity
the placing of every thing in its place

pairs.ja: ואעטא כל ד'י פצ'ילה מן אלעלם ואלמאל
pairs.en: and giving every possessor of excellence of knowledge and wealth
according to what he is worthy of
as the Friend (peace be upon him) said
Do not withhold good
